$comment: PATCH access control. Edit this file and restart the listener.

admin.description: Can nominate, confirm, approve repairs, and change model routing.

operator.description: Can nominate and confirm a truth change, but not change model routing.

$notes: Members are matched on Slack email, display name, or user id — case-insensitive.
Anyone not listed is a viewer: they see every card and every result, and can ask
PATCH to read a message, but cannot start a search or cause a write.
'view' is intentionally everyone. Hiding the reasoning would defeat the point:
the audit trail is only useful if the team can read it.
Slack user ids (U…) are the most reliable key: a display name only resolves when the profile lookup succeeds.
